C1.worst_defect: The hero and the two buttons are clear, but the home page's 'Before you start' list hands a newcomer build-it-yourself jargon ('you need your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)') that means nothing to someone who has not tried the demo yet.

C2.worst_defect: The comparison table says the demo sends 'anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com' but never says who or what wcpos is, so a visitor who just learned the name VendurePOS sees an unrelated domain collecting data and wonders whose product this really is.
C2.where: home/desktop/02 'Live demo or your own store' table, last row; home/phone/04

C3.worst_defect: The quick start opens by giving two addresses for the same till ('The hosted POS is live at https://app.vendurepos.com. https://vendurepos.vercel.app serves the same build.'), and step 3 then offers three ways to migrate, so a first-time installer has to stop and work out which one to follow.
C3.where: quick-start/desktop/01 intro paragraph and 'Other ways to run the migration' box on quick-start/desktop/02

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written in internal protocol language ('order.create v5 custom lines are real order lines on a plugin-owned, disabled POS custom item variant', 'ADR 0005', 'advertises order.create 1-5'), so a reader can't tell what changed for them without decoding it.

C5.worst_defect: The hero product screenshot is cut mid-row, with a row of half-visible product tiles along its bottom edge, so the main image looks clipped rather than framed.
C5.where: home/desktop/01 bottom of the till screenshot (~y 1140); same in home.desktop-dark

C6.worst_defect: On the phone the home header shows only the logo, a search icon and a chevron: 'Docs' and 'Live demo' are hidden, and in the hero screenshot the quantity column header is truncated to 'Q...'.
C6.where: home/phone/01 header and cart table header

C7.worst_defect: The share card crops the till screenshot at the bottom edge, cutting the product tiles and the 'Add charge' button in half; otherwise the scores are Lighthouse 99/100/100/100 and llms.txt, sitemap, robots, search API and the 404 all work.

overall_worst.defect: The home page names 'ph.wcpos.com' as the place the demo sends usage events without ever introducing wcpos, so to a first-time visitor the product seems to report to an unexplained third party.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/02 comparison table, row 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline'; home/phone/04
overall_worst.fix: Say who it is in the same cell, for example 'to our own self-hosted analytics server (ph.wcpos.com, run by the WCPOS team behind VendurePOS)', or drop the hostname from the home page and leave it on the linked page.
